ObsessiveAnnunciation.description: All enemy units adjacent to <style="Faction_EmperorsChildren">Adamatar</style> take <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmg]} Damage</style> from ranged attacks. If an enemy was <style="Overkill">Overkilled</style> this turn, enemies adjacent to Adamatar take <style="Stat_CritDamage">+{[extraCritDmg]} Crit Damage</style> from all attacks by friendly <style="Aliance_Chaos">Chaos</style> units.
